fix_summary: In TTLCache.put, eviction occurs only when len(_entries) > max_entries. This allows one extra entry (e.g., 129 when max is 128). Change the condition to use ">=" so eviction happens when the cache is full before inserting the new item.
suggested_test: Create a TTLCache with max_entries=2. Insert keys a and b, assert cache.size() == 2. Insert key c, then assert cache.size() == 2 and that the oldest of {a,b} has been evicted.
